name: experiment-C-bug3-whitebox
description: Experiment C, BUG-3 with a rare trigger: the initial battery is at least 0.2, so the faulty low-battery branch (battery < 0.1) is only reached when a scenario drains the battery during the episode. Compares random testing, black-box robustness guidance and white-box guidance (approach level + branch distance to low-battery-boost:true, then robustness). Same budget; success = velocity failure found.
